document_revisions_source_check.name: document_revisions_source_check
document_revisions_source_check.value: ("document_revisions"."client_instance_id" IS NULL) = ("document_revisions"."kind" = 'created') AND ("document_revisions"."client_instance_id" IS NULL) = ("document_revisions"."local_seq" IS NULL)

spaces_personal_check.name: spaces_personal_check
spaces_personal_check.value: "spaces"."type" <> 'personal' OR ("spaces"."owner_user_id" IS NOT NULL AND "spaces"."created_by" IS NULL AND NOT "spaces"."visible_to_all" AND "spaces"."status" = 'active')

spaces_team_check.name: spaces_team_check
spaces_team_check.value: "spaces"."type" <> 'team' OR ("spaces"."owner_user_id" IS NULL AND "spaces"."created_by" IS NOT NULL)
